originality.rationale: The full primary 2026 paper expressly conjectures gamma simplex minimality and gives a functional formula, while Billera–Ehrenborg proves cd-index minimality. The extracted dual ordinary-face-count identity, sharp first gamma inequality and exact low-dimension conjecture resolution were not identified in primary inspected material, searchable web records or accessible claims, despite being derivable from their combination. Residual risk of unindexed prior observations remains.
residual_risks: The published results are sufficient proof ingredients; independently discovered unstated corollaries may exist outside indexed sources.

value.rationale: The theorem addresses an explicit 2026 open conjecture, computes a dual-sensitive invariant of stellahedral transforms solely from the ordinary f-vector in every dimension, isolates a sharp simplex threshold with equality characterization, proves the complete conjecture up to dimension four, and shows why direct positive-coefficient transfer fails in degree five. It provides a motivated structural baseline, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
